summary: GigCapital7 Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting a Second Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with Hadron Energy. The amendment adjusts the valuation of the target company and extends the outside date. The original agreement provided for Merger Sub to merge with Hadron Energy, with the surviving corporation issuing aggregate merger consideration of 100 million shares valued at $1 billion, based on a Public Company (Pre-Capital Raise) Valuation of $1.2002 billion divided by $10.59. This filing updates deal terms in a SPAC merger. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.
